title: console: a full-page record form opened by direct URL saves silently and then leaves the app for /_console/home
body:
domain:devx#1 · sunhaolin · session_017xRBcVkGJizGH7raJHhAvL

Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect found by a QA run (off-clause probe, RUNNER rule 8). It sits beside the #26461 fix, which holds for in-app entry.

## Reproduction
1. Boot the showcase and sign in as admin.
2. Load `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/new` as a fresh document: paste the URL, open it in a new tab, or follow a deep link.
3. Fill Title and Project, then click Create.
4. Expected: the record is created, a toast reads `Task "TITLE" created` (as it does when /new is reached by in-app navigation), and the user stays in the app.
5. Actual: `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_task` 201, then a full document load to `/_console/home`. No toast is ever visible, and the user lands outside the app they were in. Reproduced twice. `/record/ID/edit` entered the same way likely behaves the same.

## Mechanism
`RecordFormPage` returns with a history `goBack`. With no in-app history entry, that crosses the document boundary, so the post-save toast is lost with the unloaded document and the user lands on the console home. The fallback when there is no prior in-app entry should be the record (or the object list), not history back.
